title: ATX Soccer Stadium: Housing, Costs, & Control
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   **Affordable Housing Ensured:** New terms require the MLS team to ensure affordable housing is built on the McKalla site, clarifying targets for families earning 60-80% of the median income.
*   **Shared Control of Future Development:** Any additional development on the stadium property will need mutual agreement between the city and the team, subject to final City Council approval.
*   **Team to Cover Event-Related City Costs:** The MLS team, not the city, will be responsible for off-site resources like police services for games and stadium events.
*   **Transit Investment & Contract Enforcement:** The deal includes a $3 million team contribution for Cap Metro transit improvements, alongside significant debate on legal enforceability of contract terms.
